opening.text: I feel dizzy and nauseated. It started two days ago, and each episode lasts 20 to 30 minutes. It feels like the room is spinning around me, and sometimes I feel unsteady, as if I were going to fall down. I also have difficulty hearing you in my left ear. By the way, I have hypertension, diagnosed seven years ago, and I take furosemide and captopril for my blood pressure.
